entities.name: Muhammad Ali, Prince of the Sa'id

entities.summary: Mohamed Ali Farouk, also known as Muhammad Ali, is an Egyptian businessman and heir apparent to the head of the Muhammad Ali dynasty, as the elder son of the former monarch of Egypt, King Fuad II.
